name: io.github.johnsmithxy1mmm-sys/predmarket-mcp
description: Prediction-market intelligence for agents. Cross-venue mispricings with REALIZABLE edge (net of fees, gas and slippage) across Polymarket and Kalshi, plus analysis no aggregator offers: scenario propagation across the market graph, logical-entailment arbitrage, implied distributions, and a server whose own forecasts are publicly Brier-scored against the market. Free discovery tier; paid realtime tools priced per call via x402.
